selector.rationale: Necrobiosis Lipoidica best explains the clinical and pathological findings, including the presence of reddish brown hyperkeratotic papules, compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis.

rejected.label: Granuloma annulare
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic granulomatous inflammation and less specific clinical presentation
